name: Marken Bild
description: One row per hero/gallery image on a Marken record. Row order (built-in idx) is the display/slider order; row [0] is also the Open Graph/Twitter/JSON-LD image on the brand-story page.

fields.label: Bild
fields.description: Canonical image-file field for this row, spelled with ONE 'n' (bild_anhagen) — matches how every frontend file reads it (marke.bild_anhagen[i].bild_anhagen). Do not rename to bild_anhangen (that spelling belongs to the unrelated Produkte Bild child table).
